title: Agent Lifecycle Plugin System
description: Add lifecycle hook middleware to BaseAgent enabling perception→planning→execution→reflection pipeline. Inspired by OpenStory's plugin architecture. Existing agents work unchanged — lifecycle participation is opt-in via addHook().
action: Create src-ts/agents/lifecycle-hooks.ts with AgentLifecycleHook type and LifecycleStage enum (perception, planning, execution, reflection). Add addHook(stage, handler) and runLifecycle(context) methods to BaseAgent in src-ts/agents/base.ts. Hook handlers receive AgentContext and return modified AgentContext. Update factory.ts to accept lifecycle config during agent creation. Export from agents/index.ts.

convergence.verification: Import { LifecycleStage, AgentLifecycleHook } from agents/lifecycle-hooks. Create a test agent extending BaseAgent, register hooks via addHook(), call runLifecycle() and verify hooks execute in order.
convergence.definition_of_done: BaseAgent supports optional lifecycle hooks that agents can register for perception, planning, execution, and reflection stages. Existing agents compile and pass tests unchanged.

files.change: New file: LifecycleStage enum, AgentLifecycleHook type, LifecycleHookRegistry class
Add protected hooks: LifecycleHookRegistry field, addHook(stage, handler) method, protected async runLifecycle(context) method that runs hooks for given stage
Accept optional lifecycleConfig in agent creation options, register hooks on created agent

implementation: Create src-ts/agents/lifecycle-hooks.ts: define LifecycleStage enum { PERCEPTION, PLANNING, EXECUTION, REFLECTION }, AgentLifecycleHook type as (context: AgentContext) => Promise<AgentContext>, and LifecycleHookRegistry class with register(stage, hook) and async execute(stage, context) methods

In src-ts/agents/base.ts: add protected hookRegistry = new LifecycleHookRegistry() field, add addHook(stage: LifecycleStage, handler: AgentLifecycleHook): void method, add protected async runLifecycle(stage: LifecycleStage, context: AgentContext): Promise<AgentContext> that delegates to hookRegistry.execute()

In src-ts/agents/factory.ts: extend AgentCreationOptions with optional lifecycleHooks: Array<{stage: LifecycleStage, handler: AgentLifecycleHook}>, after creating agent instance call agent.addHook() for each configured hook
In src-ts/agents/index.ts: add export { LifecycleStage, AgentLifecycleHook, LifecycleHookRegistry } from './lifecycle-hooks'
Verify: cd src-ts && npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors

commands: cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/agents/lifecycle-hooks.test.ts
unit: LifecycleHookRegistry: register hook → execute runs it in order
LifecycleHookRegistry: no hooks → execute returns context unchanged
BaseAgent: addHook stores hook, runLifecycle executes it
Factory: lifecycleHooks config → agent has hooks registered

reference.pattern: OpenStory Agent-Kernel lifecycle: perception → planning → execution → reflection as pluggable stages
reference.examples: sequential-thinking.ts already implements a form of multi-step reasoning — lifecycle hooks generalize this pattern

rationale.chosen_approach: Opt-in middleware on existing BaseAgent rather than new base class
decision_factors: Zero breaking changes to existing agents
Aligns with OpenStory's proven plugin pattern
Enables future agents to participate in structured reasoning pipeline
rationale.tradeoffs: Slightly more indirection than direct method calls, but enables powerful composable behaviors

risks: Hook execution order must be deterministic — use array, not Set
